mission: Add Forgejo as the sovereign Git/control-plane mirror for CryptoAID without disrupting GitHub main during MVP closure.

architecture.promotion_rule: Forgejo may become canonical only after backup/restore, runner, authentication and branch-protection gates pass.

runtime_tests_required: admin bootstrap succeeds without secrets committed
mirror script transfers main, branches and tags
fresh clone from Forgejo matches GitHub main HEAD
backup Forgejo /data and perform restore drill
verify registration disabled and protected main
security: never commit Forgejo tokens or credentials
next_action: Run the runtime tests on the developer host, return factual logs/results, then wire Forgejo Actions runner only after the base service is healthy.
